mechanisms.technique: Regex enforcement at pack-creation time + governance guard structural check
mechanisms.detail: P2 items use P2-{Section}-{NNN} (e.g., P2-A-001). Part 1 items use P1-{Section}-{NNN}. P2- prefix is structurally enforced: any item in a pack_p2_*.js file with a P1- QID → governance guard BLOCK. Any item with a QID not matching /^P2-[A-F]-\d{3}$/ → ExplanationValidator_P2 error.
mechanisms.enforcement: Governance guard structural check + validator regex

mechanisms.detail: P2 cases use CBQ2{Pack}-{Section}{Seq} (e.g., CBQ2-A1). P1 cases use CBQ{Pack}-{Section}{Seq} (e.g., CBQ-B2). P2 items within cases use CBQ2{Pack}-{Section}{Seq}-Q{N}. In a separate repo, collision is structurally impossible. In a co-located repo, the prefix provides unambiguous routing.
mechanisms.enforcement: CaseID format validator + governance guard file-context check

mechanisms.technique: Mandatory boolean field on every item
mechanisms.detail: Every P2 item must carry Part2OnlyFlag: true. This is the single field that prevents cross-contamination. The flag is verified at every certification gate (§E.4), at G5 metadata review, and by the governance guard Rule 11 at write time. Items without this flag are blocked from both P1 and P2 pools. Items with Part2OnlyFlag: false or absent → BLOCK certification.
mechanisms.enforcement: Governance guard Rule 11 BLOCK + G5 metadata validator + Certification pipeline gate

mechanisms.detail: If P2 is in its own repo, cross-contamination is architecturally prevented — no P1 file can accidentally be loaded as P2 content. The QID prefix and Part2OnlyFlag provide defense-in-depth even in a separate repo. If co-located, the prefix + flag provide circuit-breaker protection.
mechanisms.enforcement: Repository boundary (if separate) + QID prefix + Part2OnlyFlag

mechanisms.detail: pack_p2_a.js through pack_p2_e.js, case_pack_p2_1.js through case_pack_p2_3.js. The _p2_ infix ensures no collision with P1 files (pack_a_corrected.js, scored_cases.js). Even in co-located deployment, the application's pack-loading logic can unambiguously distinguish P1 and P2 content sources.
mechanisms.enforcement: Governance guard SOURCE_FILE_RE + application pack-loading configuration

qid_routing_rules.collision_check: validator must reject any item in pack_p2_*.js with a P1- QID, and any item with a P2- QID in a pack_*_corrected.js file. Cross-check at pack-load time.

part2onlyflag_enforcement.allowed_on: Every item in pack_p2_*.js and case_pack_p2_*.js
part2onlyflag_enforcement.prohibited_on: No P1 item should carry this field — if present on P1 item, flag as cross-contamination
part2onlyflag_enforcement.error_handling: Absent → BLOCK, false → BLOCK, non-boolean → BLOCK, falsy → BLOCK

domain_boundary_rules.description: P1-exclusive concepts must not appear as primary tested material in P2. These are Part 1-only topics that, if found in a P2 item, indicate cross-contamination.
part1_exclusives: Standard costing variances (DM, DL, VOH, FOH)
Joint product cost allocation (NRV, physical measures)
COSO IC 2013 detailed control procedures (at procedure level — framework awareness is permitted)
Technology operational details (SDLC phases, DRP, BCP procedures)
part2_permitted_overlap: CVP analysis (breakeven) — appears in both parts, P2 tests at higher Bloom's levels
Relevant costing / differential analysis — appears in both parts
Ethical principles — both parts, P2 tests deeper application (FCPA, SOX, IMA decision model)
COSO framework awareness — P2 references COSO ERM (2017), not COSO IC (2013)
domain_boundary_rules.enforcement: During G1 Technical Review, the Accountant must verify every item's topic against the P1 Exclusives list. Any item testing a Part 1 exclusive as its primary concept → BLOCK certification. CAQS_P2 §E.3 enforcement. Governance guard checks for COSO IC component names (Control Environment, Control Activities, Monitoring Activities) in Domain D items → WARN.

dl_008_prevention.recurrence_risk: High (highest-frequency structural defect in P1: 539 occurrences)
dl_008_prevention.validator_check: ExplanationValidator_P2 — EW[CC] must be empty string
dl_008_prevention.certification_gate: G6 Final Validation — verify zero DL-008 in certification batch
dl_008_prevention.structural_prevention: Single-object architecture — CorrectChoice and ExplanationWrong fields are co-located in one JSON object. No CC-offset scanning false positives (DL-029 eliminated). The findDL008Violations() function extracts CC from same object as EW fields.
dl_008_prevention.procedural_prevention: Governance guard Rule 2 scans newContent at every write/edit. Authoring template must be configured to set EW[CC]='' for the correct answer slot. Post-generation hook verifies before save.
dl_008_prevention.verified_by: Governance guard test suite Rule 2 test block. Full-pool scan after every certification wave.

dl_021_prevention.defect: Missing distractor ExplanationWrong fields (absent non-CC slots)
dl_021_prevention.recurrence_risk: High (Pack E Section C: 100 items with zero distractor EW fields)
dl_021_prevention.governance_rule: Rule 10 — BLOCK absent/empty non-CC EW fields at write time
dl_021_prevention.validator_check: ExplanationValidator_P2 — all 4 EW fields must be structurally present (hasOwnProperty check), distractor slots must be non-empty (≥50 characters)
dl_021_prevention.certification_gate: G6 Final Validation — verify 0 DL-021 violations in certification batch
dl_021_prevention.structural_prevention: Single-object architecture — all 4 EW fields in one object eliminates template-rotation omission risk (P1 Pack E Section C root cause). Authoring template must emit all 4 EW fields per item regardless of CC.
dl_021_prevention.procedural_prevention: Governance guard Rule 10 checks at write time: field must be present AND non-empty for distractor slots. Authoring template post-generation hook: verify 4 EW fields exist, CC slot empty, distractor slots ≥50 chars. Section-level sweep after initial batch authoring.

dl_026_prevention.recurrence_risk: Medium (1,005 items affected in P1 across 3 packs)
dl_026_prevention.governance_rule: Rule 6 — BLOCK empty non-CC EW slots at write time
dl_026_prevention.validator_check: ExplanationValidator_P2 — all 3 non-CC EW slots must have ≥50 characters of choice-specific text
dl_026_prevention.certification_gate: G6 Final Validation — verify 0 DL-026 violations in certification batch
dl_026_prevention.structural_prevention: Single-object architecture eliminates the P1 rotation-artifact root cause (5-item template leaving one slot empty in lockstep with CC rotation). All 4 EW fields in one object → all or nothing.
dl_026_prevention.procedural_prevention: Governance guard Rule 6 BLOCK at write time. Authoring template post-generation hook: verify all 3 non-CC EW slots have choice-specific text ≥50 characters. No template-generated empty slots. Per-item diff check during certification: all 3 distractor slots non-empty before state transition.
dl_026_prevention.minimum_text_requirement: 50 characters per non-CC EW slot. Enforcement: structural (Rule 6 blocks short strings at write time) and procedural (G5 metadata review verifies length).

dl_037_prevention.defect: Choice binary lead-in polarity mismatch ('No' / 'Yes' contradicted by conclusion)
dl_037_prevention.validator_check: Full-pool semantic scan after each certification wave (scripts/scan_logic_inversions_p2.js)
dl_037_prevention.certification_gate: G2 Psychometric Review (catch during manual review) + G6 Final Validation (automated scan)
dl_037_prevention.structural_prevention: Language-level defect — no structural prevention possible. Must be procedural.
dl_037_prevention.procedural_prevention: Governance guard Rule 9 BLOCK at write time: PATTERN_NO_AFFIRMATIVE and PATTERN_YES_NEGATIVE regexes scan all choice text. Authoring standards: choices beginning with Yes/No must align the binary lead-in with the logical conclusion. Full-pool scan after each certification wave.
dl_037_prevention.p2_pattern_expansion_notes: P2 may introduce new Yes/No patterns specific to decision analysis (accept/reject, make/buy, invest/do-not-invest). Extend regex patterns if needed based on P2 authoring patterns.

dl_013_prevention.defect: Template boilerplate distractor explanations (generic text reused across slots)
dl_013_prevention.recurrence_risk: High (single-highest-volume defect class: 2,587 occurrences in P1)
dl_013_prevention.governance_rule: Rule 6 (empty slots) + CAQS §4.4 EV2 (no placeholder phrases) — no dedicated boilerplate rule
dl_013_prevention.validator_check: CAQS_P2 §4 extension: ExplanationValidator_P2 checks for template boilerplate patterns. Initial authorized patterns: 'represents a plausible misconception', 'does not align with', 'Option X... is incorrect', 'A candidate selecting this option may misunderstand'. Add P2-specific boilerplate patterns as they emerge from P2 template authoring.
dl_013_prevention.certification_gate: G4 Instructional Review — editor must verify each distractor explanation is choice-specific and free of boilerplate.
dl_013_prevention.structural_prevention: NONE — template boilerplate is a content-quality defect, not structural. Cannot be architecturally prevented.
dl_013_prevention.procedural_prevention: Authoring template design: DISTRACTOR EXPLANATIONS MUST BE AUTHORED INDIVIDUALLY — NO TEMPLATE TEXT. Each distractor slot requires unique text written for its specific choice. Post-generation Jaccard similarity check: if any two distractor EW fields within the same item have >50% word overlap, flag for review. CAQS §4.4 EV2: no placeholder phrases. CAQS §4.4 EV4: distractor explanations must be choice-specific (not identical across slots).

dl_031_prevention.defect: Difficulty inflation — definition-match items labeled Moderate (should be Easy)
dl_031_prevention.governance_rule: No dedicated guard rule — enforced via G2 Psychometric Review and certification blocking conditions
dl_031_prevention.validator_check: DifficultyCalibrationValidator (deferred until D04 — first 100+ items). Checks: stem-CorrectChoice lexical overlap >50% + distractors are definition-level opposites → flag for recalibration. If all distractors require genuine application-level discernment → may retain Moderate label.
dl_031_prevention.certification_gate: G2 Psychometric Review — psychometrician must verify difficulty label matches cognitive demand. Definition-match items default to Easy (1) unless distractors justify higher difficulty.
dl_031_prevention.structural_prevention: NONE — difficulty calibration is a pedagogical judgment, not a structural property.
dl_031_prevention.procedural_prevention: Per-item cognitive justification required before certification. No template-based difficulty labeling (P1 root cause: fixed difficulty assignment pattern per rotation-group position). Each item's DifficultyScore must be justified by: (a) Bloom's level, (b) calculation complexity, (c) distractor deceptiveness, (d) number of reasoning steps required. Definition-match checklist: stem-defines-concept → correct-answer-is-term → default to Easy unless distractors require Application-level discernment.

dl_030_prevention.defect: CorrectChoice answer-key errors (stored CC disagrees with independently derived answer)
dl_030_prevention.recurrence_risk: Critical (5 Certified P1 items had wrong answers. P2 has more complex calculations → higher risk)
dl_030_prevention.governance_rule: Rule 4 — answer-key changes require recomputed note. Rule 11 — Part2OnlyFlag prevents P1 answer-key migration.
dl_030_prevention.validator_check: G3 Numerical Validation — mandatory independent recalculation for ALL P2 calculation items (not spot-check — full population)
dl_030_prevention.certification_gate: G3 Numerical Validation + G1 Technical Review. BLOCK: any item where independent recalculation result disagrees with stored Correct value. Must be resolved before certification.
dl_030_prevention.structural_prevention: NONE — answer-key correctness is a content-quality requirement. No structural enforcement can verify accounting correctness.
dl_030_prevention.procedural_prevention: Mandatory blind recalculation protocol per P2002_CERTIFICATION_STANDARD.md §D.4: (1) Read stem and exhibits. (2) Do NOT read stored Correct value. (3) Solve independently showing formula + substituted values + result. (4) Compare to stored answer. (5) Reconcile differences. Document recalculation in certification entry. Cover all 52 P2 formulas. Highest-priority formulas for independent verification: WACC, CAPM, NPV, DuPont ROE, breakeven multi-product, after-tax cash flow, transfer price, EOQ. Note: P1's DL-030 escaped detection because certification waves did NOT perform mandatory independent recalculation on all items — spot-check sampling missed 5 wrong answers. P2 must NOT repeat this: 100% population independent recalculation is non-negotiable.

implementation_order.name: Create P2 repository and directory structure
implementation_order.rationale: Repository must exist before any files can be created. Create root with all subdirectories (knowledge/, scripts/, foundation/, reports/, ai/, review/, backups/, .opencode/plugins/).

implementation_order.name: Create empty knowledge and foundation files
implementation_order.rationale: All reference documents must exist before the governance guard (which references them in error messages and file-pattern checks). P2-004 needs these to validate the first question against.

implementation_order.name: Create empty pack and case pack files
implementation_order.rationale: Pack file skeletons must exist before governance guard can verify them (SOURCE_FILE_RE pattern match). P2-004 writes directly into these files.

implementation_order.name: Fork and adapt governance-guard.js
implementation_order.rationale: The governance guard is the single most critical artifact — it enforces Rules 1-11 at write time. Must be deployed before any content write. This is the hard gate: if the governance guard isn't functioning, P2-004 cannot start.
implementation_order.dependencies: Steps 1-3 (files and directories exist for pattern matching)

implementation_order.name: Create governance guard test suite and verify all 11 rules
implementation_order.rationale: The test suite proves the governance guard works before any content is authored. Must achieve 55+/55 PASS before P2-004 begins. This is the evidence that governance enforcement is live.

implementation_order.name: Fork and adapt validator infrastructure
implementation_order.rationale: Validators and registry builder are the second line of defense (governance guard is first). Must be deployed and tested on empty packs before content exists.
implementation_order.dependencies: Steps 2-3 (reference files and pack files exist for validation targets)

implementation_order.name: Create AGENTS.md and CONSTITUTION for P2
implementation_order.rationale: These are the session-level governance documents. P2-004 needs them to understand its operational constraints. Can be created in parallel with step 6.

implementation_order.name: Run full governance verification — T0 pre-flight
implementation_order.rationale: Before declaring the bootstrap complete, run the complete governance verification: (a) governance guard test suite 55+ PASS, (b) ExplanationValidator parses all 5 empty packs without error, (c) build_master_registry_p2.js produces valid empty registry, (d) all knowledge/foundation files present with correct headers, (e) pack files parse cleanly, (f) SHA-256 hashes written to CURRENT_BASELINES_P2.md §5, (g) opencode.json references governance-guard-p2.js as the active plugin.

governance_guard_test_plan.minimum_pass_rate: 100% (55/55) — no test may fail before P2-004 begins

critical_risks.risk: Governance guard not deployed before first P2 content write
critical_risks.probability: Low (P2-003 bootstrap document gates on it)
critical_risks.impact: HIGH — all structural defects that plagued P1 (DL-008, DL-021, DL-026, DL-037) could be introduced into P2 from Day 1. Remediation effort would be 100-1000x the prevention effort.
critical_risks.mitigation: M01 and M02 are mandatory-before-P2-004 items. P2-004 pre-flight check verifies governance guard test suite 55/55 PASS.

critical_risks.risk: Single-object architecture not enforced — dual-block creeps in via template authoring
critical_risks.probability: Medium (template engines may emit dual-block by default)
critical_risks.impact: HIGH — reintroduces DL-016, DL-029, CC-offset scanning false positives. The single biggest architectural win of P2 over P1 would be lost.
critical_risks.mitigation: Governance guard Rule 2 extractObjectsFromText() verifies single-object per-item. Authoring template must be validated to emit single-object format. Post-generation structural verification.

critical_risks.risk: Part2OnlyFlag absent on early items — sets precedent
critical_risks.impact: HIGH — items without Part2OnlyFlag cannot be distinguished from P1 items. Cross-contamination risk. Retroactive flag addition is error-prone (DL-024 lesson: 150 P1 items missed question_state).
critical_risks.mitigation: Governance guard Rule 11 BLOCK write-time. G5 metadata review. Certification pipeline gate. Post-generation hook.

critical_risks.risk: DL-030 answer-key errors — P2's complex formulas increase error rate
critical_risks.probability: Medium-High (more complex formulas: WACC, CAPM, NPV vs P1's simpler calculations)
critical_risks.impact: Critical — wrong answer in learner pool. P1 had 5 Certified items with wrong answers despite spot-check verification.
critical_risks.mitigation: Mandatory 100% population independent recalculation (not spot-check). G3 Numerical Validation gate. FORMULA_MASTER_P2.md with common errors documented per formula. See P2002_CERTIFICATION_STANDARD.md §E.1.

medium_risks.risk: P2 authorities confused with P1 authorities (COSO IC cited instead of COSO ERM)
medium_risks.probability: High (authoring familiarity bias — authors who worked on P1 may default to P1 authorities)
medium_risks.impact: Medium — incorrect authority citation is a DL-009-pattern defect. Not a wrong answer, but wrong reference.
medium_risks.mitigation: AUTHORITY_TO_TOPIC_MAP_P2.md created before Domain D/E authoring. CAQS §E.2 authority verification table. Governance guard Rule 11 dimension: cross-reference COSO framework names.

medium_risks.risk: Domain boundary violation — P1 concepts accidentally tested in P2 items
medium_risks.probability: Medium (authors may not know P1-exclusives list)
medium_risks.impact: Medium — tests wrong exam content. Would be caught at G1 Technical Review but could slip through if reviewer lacks P1 knowledge.
medium_risks.mitigation: CAQS_P2 §E.3 with explicit P1-exclusives list. G1 Technical Review checklist item: 'No P1-only concept tested as primary.' Governance guard can WARN on P1-exclusive keywords in P2 files.

medium_risks.risk: Difficulty inflation via template-based labeling (DL-031 pattern)
medium_risks.probability: High (same root cause as P1 — template rotation assignment of difficulty)
medium_risks.impact: Medium — systematic miscalibration requiring bulk recalibration later.
medium_risks.mitigation: No template-based difficulty labeling. Per-item cognitive justification required. DifficultyCalibrationValidator deployed after 100+ items (D04).
